vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraced.br: Linear multiplier for the brightness of all block lights. Does not affect their radius.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraced.ra: The radius (in chunks) from the camera where block lights will cast shadows.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraced.re: The radius (in chunks) from the camera where block lights will be visible.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraced.sh: The radius (in blocks) from each block light where blocks will cast shadows.
Higher values increases shadow quality, but also increases memory usage and update time.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraced.ma: The maximum number of block lights that will be rendered, closest lights first.
The maximum number of block lights that will cast shadows, closest lights first.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.subtle.brigh: Linear multiplier for the brightness of all block lights. Does not affect their radius.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.subtle.rende: The radius (in chunks) from the camera where block lights will be visible.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.subtle.maxRe: The maximum number of block lights that will be rendered, closest lights first.
